response.final_analysis: Tocilizumab is a monoclonal antibody that targets the interleukin-6 receptor, used in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis to reduce inflammation by blocking the receptor and thus inhibiting the pro-inflammatory effects of interleukin-6.
